source_text: For instance, modeling for a cohort of 1,000 circumcised newborns projected prevention of approximately 100-200 UTIs in infancy alone (given a baseline 1% incidence reduced to 0.1%), alongside lifetime reductions in penile cancer (3-22 cases averted per 100,000) and certain STIs, against 2-10 minor adverse events per 1,000 procedures. [44]
